title: Vibrant Blue Orbs
description: An abstract painting featuring numerous circular blue orbs of varying sizes with swirling vortex patterns, set against a dynamic background of swirling brushstrokes in fiery orange, red, pink, and yellow hues. Small blue and black dots are scattered throughout the composition.
prompt: Abstract painting with multiple blue orbs and circles of different sizes featuring swirling vortex centers, set against energetic swirling brushstrokes in bright orange, red, pink and yellow, with scattered small blue and black dots throughout the composition, vibrant colorful abstract art with dynamic flow and movement
